title: Lady Gaga's Fiancé Doesn't Want To Be Her 'Career Manager' - Source - NewsBreak
text:
By Evolve Editors ,
1 hours ago Photo Credit: Taylor Hill/FilmMagic via Getty Images Lady Gaga’s fiancé, Michael Polansky, reportedly wants to avoid getting labeled as the “Born This Way” singer’s “career manager.” The venture capitalist and entrepreneur has been a pivotal part of the multiple Grammy Award-winning artist’s comeback journey. He served as an executive producer for the singer’s latest album, “MAYHEM.” He also acted as a co-writer for some of her recent songs, including “Disease.” Thus, it may allegedly seem that the entrepreneur has a “managerial role” in the artist’s music career. However, he reportedly does not wish to be seen as that.
Michael Polansky ‘doesn’t want to be seen as a manager of Lady Gaga’s career,’ per source Lady Gaga’s fiancé, Michael Polansky, allegedly does not want the label of being the “Bad Romance” singer’s “career manager.” As reported by the Daily Mail , a source told them that “It would appear that Michael is taking a managerial role with her career.” The person continued, “But they don’t see it as that nor do they want that to be the case.” The source then claimed, “They will work together.” The person also added, “But he doesn’t want to be seen as a manager of her career.”
In the meantime, the insider further went on to say to the news outlet that for Michael Polansky , being a “contributor is fine,” when it comes to his participation in Lady Gaga’s music career. The insider then explained, “But at the end of the day, she is her own manager if anything.” The person continued, “It’s not often that you see a couple that reminds you of the movies.” They added, “But that’s really their relationship at this moment.”
The source further gushed to the news outlet about Lady Gaga and Michael Polansky’s romantic relationship, “It’s wild to see that this can actually happen.” The person continued, “As you’d only hope for this kind of love to happen to everyone.” Meanwhile, another insider said, “Life is pretty good.” According to them, the singer is “very happy.” “And Michael has been a very important reason that everything is so joyous now,” added the insider.
Originally reported by Nikita Nath on Reality Tea
The post Lady Gaga’s Fiancé Doesn’t Want To Be Her ‘Career Manager’ — Source appeared first on Mandatory .
